item: Plural forms in the locale files: Russian and Arabic counts agree with their noun
key_paths: src/static/i18n.js; src/tui/locale.py; src/static/app-core.js (_tfn); src/static/locales/{ru;ar}.json; tests/test_i18n_plural_forms.py; tests/i18n_plural_node_test.js; tests/locale_forms.py; tests/i18n_engine_node.js
summary: A value may hold one form per CLDR category ([one]...[few]...[many]...[other]...); tf() picks it with the browser's Intl.PluralRules on n, else count, else the key's first placeholder; t() and the DOM walker take [other]; the terminal panel uses its own rules, pinned equal to Intl for ru and ar. 172 ru and 351 ar strings converted, each drafted by one read and checked by a second (17 second-read fixes used, one ar string left as it was); the strings whose noun agrees with a different number stay as before. Thirteen call sites that welded a count into t() now go through tf(); the source-candidate promote/dismiss toasts are keyed. Tests that compare a value's placeholders read the [other] form (tests/locale_forms.py); every form's placeholders are pinned once. Native review list: project folder plural-2026-11-14/native-review.md.
